cohort: A total of 206 asymptomatic pregnant women (103 low-risk and 103 high-risk) admitted to hospital for delivery were screened for SARS-CoV-2.
finding: Three out of 206 asymptomatic pregnant women (1.4%) admitted for delivery tested positive for SARS-CoV-2, with all positive cases found in the high-risk pregnancy group, resulting in a significantly higher positivity rate in this group (2.9% vs 0%).
